raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
> **Superseded by #46986; closing.** The window-draft backend list this PR extended (`WINDOW_RAIL_BACKENDS` in `mem_cache/layout/fused_draft.py`) was removed by #46986, which binds fused drafts to routed KV views and no longer checks the attention backend when it places a draft. On unmodified main (`76d5b3ce02`, SM90), MiMo-V2-Flash's NEXTN draft, sliding-window layers included, fuses on fa3 under `--enable-unified-memory`, and GSM8K matches the default pool (all 1314 questions, greedy, paired by question, CUDA graphs on). The FlashAttention tests this PR added to pin that behavior pass on main unchanged.
>
> The original description follows for reference.

---

## Motivation

With `--enable-unified-memory`, a speculative draft fuses its KV into the target's pool pages. A fused draft's sliding-window layers need each draft step to read its own window and write its own slots. The "swa" host kind admitted only Triton, the backend those reads and writes were first built for. So a draft with sliding-window layers (MiMo-V2-Flash's MTP head) on fa3 was declined, and on a hybrid sliding-window target an EAGLE draft that does not fuse is refused at boot: MiMo-V2-Flash with MTP on fa3 could not use the unified pool.

The FlashAttention backend already has what the fused window draft needs. Under the unified pool it reads every window layer through the iteration plan's sliding-window table, refilled from the plan on CUDA graph replay for draft decode and draft extend, and `_get_swa_write_locations` gives each multi-step draft step its own columns of the window's write ids.

## Modifications

- `WINDOW_RAIL_BACKENDS` (`mem_cache/layout/fused_draft.py`) now admits fa3.

Tests (CPU):
- `test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_fused_draft_placement.py`: the placement case that admits an fa3 window draft fails before this change and passes after; flashinfer stays the refused example.
- `test/registered/unit/layers/attention/test_flashattention_graph_metadata.py` and `test_cuda_graph_window_rail_completeness.py` pin the FA behavior the gate relies on (green before and after): each multi-step draft step's window write ids are its own columns, a multi-layer draft extend writes the whole window, and every FA function that fills the plan's full-attention table also fills the window one.

## Accuracy Tests

SM90, `XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2-Flash`, TP 4, `--attention-backend fa3`, `--speculative-algorithm NEXTN --speculative-draft-model-path XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2-Flash --speculative-num-steps 3 --speculative-eagle-topk 1 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 4`, radix cache, overlap scheduler. GSM8K (all 1314 test questions, 5-shot, greedy, `python -m sglang.test.run_eval`), paired by question between the pools; median accept length from the scheduler logs. The unified-memory servers ran with `SGLANG_DEBUG_POISON_POOL=1`.

| CUDA graphs | GSM8K, default pool | GSM8K, `--enable-unified-memory` | questions only one pool got right (default / unified), p | accept length (default / unified) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| off | 0.833 | 0.830 | 93 / 89, p = 0.82 | 2.71 / 2.70 |
| on | 0.823 | 0.816 | 109 / 100, p = 0.58 | 2.69 / 2.71 |

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Same setup, CUDA graphs on, `--enable-unified-memory` against the default pool:

| load | req/s | median TTFT | median ITL |
|---|---|---|---|
| 100 requests of 512 input / 4096 output tokens, concurrency 128 | +74% | -66% | +52% |
| 192 requests sharing a 4096-token prefix + 128 tokens, 2048 output tokens, concurrency 192 | +71% | -64% | +50% |

The gain is capacity: the unified pool lends memory between the full-attention and sliding-window KV, so it kept about 24 requests running on average where the default pool kept about 10. Per-token latency rises with the larger batches; at equal batch size the decode step is within 1% of the default pool's.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

 )
 
-# Multi-step draft backends that build the per-step sliding-window read and

-WINDOW_RAIL_BACKENDS = frozenset({"triton"})
+# Draft backends that give each draft step its own sliding-window reads and
+# writes: Triton builds per-step rails, fa3 reads the plan's window table.
+WINDOW_RAIL_BACKENDS = frozenset({"triton", "fa3"})
 
 
 class WindowHostKind(DenseHostKind):

@@ -11,7 +11,7 @@
 # See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
 # limitations under the License.
 # ==============================================================================
-"""The multi-step draft's sliding-window rails on the Triton backend.
+"""The multi-step draft's sliding-window rails on the Triton and FA backends.
 
 Every cuda-graph forward mode must fill the sliding-window READ rail, and each
 draft step must write its window layers through its OWN columns of the
@@ -35,6 +35,7 @@
 """
 
 import ast
+import importlib.util
 import unittest
 from pathlib import Path
 from types import SimpleNamespace
@@ -172,5 +173,52 @@ def test_a_chain_draft_inside_the_verify_window(self):
         self._check(bs=3, topk=1, num_steps=3, window_cols=5)
 
 
+def _plan_table_kind(call):
+    for kw in call.keywords:
+        if kw.arg == "kind":
+            return kw.value.attr if isinstance(kw.value, ast.Attribute) else None
+    return "FULL"
+
+
+class TestFlashAttentionWindowTableFills(CustomTestCase):
+    """The FA backend's window layers read the plan's sliding-window table. A
+    function that fills the plan's full-attention table but not the window one
+    (a graph refill above all) leaves a fused draft's window layers reading an
+    earlier forward's rows: wrong drafts, no error. The fused window-draft gate
+    admits fa3 on this. A source scan, since the module needs sgl_kernel."""
+
+    def test_every_plan_table_fill_also_fills_the_window_table(self):
+        spec = importlib.util.find_spec(
+            "sglang.srt.layers.attention.flashattention_backend"
+        )
+        tree = ast.parse(Path(spec.origin).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+        fills = {}
+        for fn in ast.walk(tree):
+            if not isinstance(fn, ast.FunctionDef):
+                continue
+            kinds = {
+                _plan_table_kind(call)
+                for call in ast.walk(fn)
+                if isinstance(call, ast.Call)
+                and isinstance(call.func, ast.Attribute)
+                and call.func.attr in ("copy_page_table", "read_table")
+            }
+            if kinds:
+                fills[fn.name] = kinds
+        # A scan that finds nothing would pass vacuously forever.
+        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(fills), 3, fills)
+        missing = sorted(
+            name
+            for name, kinds in fills.items()
+            if "FULL" in kinds and "SLIDING_WINDOW" not in kinds
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(
+            missing,
+            [],
+            f"{missing} fill the plan's full-attention table without the "
+            "sliding-window one; pass kind=IdSpaceKind.SLIDING_WINDOW too.",
+        )
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()

@@ -5,8 +5,9 @@
 
 from sglang.srt.layers.attention.flashattention_backend import FlashAttentionBackend
 from sglang.srt.mem_cache.kv_index_translator import KVIndexTranslator
-from sglang.srt.mem_cache.kv_loc_plan import IdSpace, IdSpaceKind
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.kv_loc_plan import IdSpace, IdSpaceKind, KVLocPlan
 from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardMode
+from sglang.srt.speculative.eagle_utils import per_step_draft_out_cache_loc
 from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
 from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
 
@@ -266,5 +267,90 @@ def _check_replay(self, ps, use_swa):
                 torch.testing.assert_close(table.cpu(), expected)
 
 
+class _WindowReader:
+    """A translator whose sliding-window write ids are the virtual ids times
+    ten, answering `write_ids` as the production translator does."""
+
+    write_ids = KVIndexTranslator.write_ids
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self._spaces = {
+            IdSpaceKind.FULL: IdSpace(key="full"),
+            IdSpaceKind.SLIDING_WINDOW: IdSpace(key="swa", write=lambda ids: ids * 10),
+        }
+
+    def space(self, kind):
+        return self._spaces.get(kind)
+
+
+class TestDraftWindowWriteIds(CustomTestCase):
+    """A fused draft's window layers write where `_get_swa_write_locations`
+    says, derived from the whole draft window. A multi-step draft step must
+    keep its own columns (the window is laid out step-minor per row), and a
+    multi-layer draft's extend writes the whole window. The fused window-draft
+    gate admits fa3 on this."""
+
+    def _write_ids(self, *, bs, topk, num_steps, window_cols, step, mode):
+        reader = _WindowReader()
+        plan = KVLocPlan(
+            source=reader,
+            req_pool_indices=torch.arange(bs),
+            seq_lens=torch.ones(bs, dtype=torch.int64),
+            seq_lens_cpu=None,
+            write_virtual=torch.arange(1, bs * topk * window_cols + 1),
+            read_extent=0,
+        )
+        # A chain draft (topk 1) inside a wider verify window writes its
+        # leading columns; otherwise the draft owns the whole window.
+        cols = None if window_cols == num_steps else slice(0, num_steps)
+        batch = SimpleNamespace(
+            batch_size=bs,
+            kv_loc_plan=plan,
+            kv_loc_cols=cols,
+            out_cache_loc=plan.write_ids(reader, cols=cols),
+            forward_mode=mode,
+            spec_info=object(),
+        )
+        backend = FlashAttentionBackend.__new__(FlashAttentionBackend)
+        backend.kv_index_translator = reader
+        backend.topk = topk
+        backend.speculative_num_steps = num_steps
+        backend.speculative_step_id = step
+        window = plan.write_ids(reader, kind=IdSpaceKind.SLIDING_WINDOW, cols=cols)
+        return backend._get_swa_write_locations(batch), window
+
+    def test_each_draft_step_writes_its_own_columns(self):
+        for bs, topk, num_steps, window_cols in (
+            (3, 1, 3, 3),
+            (2, 2, 3, 3),
+            (3, 1, 3, 5),
+        ):
+            per_step = None
+            for step in range(num_steps):
+                ids, window = self._write_ids(
+                    bs=bs,
+                    topk=topk,
+                    num_steps=num_steps,
+                    window_cols=window_cols,
+                    step=step,
+                    mode=ForwardMode.DECODE,
+                )
+                per_step = per_step_draft_out_cache_loc(window, bs, topk, num_steps)
+                torch.testing.assert_close(ids, per_step[step], rtol=0, atol=0)
+            # Step 1's slots are not the window's leading ids.
+            self.assertFalse(torch.equal(window[: bs * topk], per_step[1]))
+
+    def test_a_multi_layer_draft_extend_writes_the_whole_window(self):
+        ids, window = self._write_ids(
+            bs=3,
+            topk=1,
+            num_steps=3,
+            window_cols=3,
+            step=1,
+            mode=ForwardMode.DRAFT_EXTEND_V2,
+        )
+        torch.testing.assert_close(ids, window, rtol=0, atol=0)
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()

         self.assertIn("cannot share", decision.declined)

-        """Only the Triton multi-step draft backend builds the per-step window
-        rails; any other draft backend would sink-write the window layers."""
+        """Only the Triton and fa3 draft backends give each draft step its own
+        window reads and writes; any other could write the window layers into
+        other steps' slots."""
+        for backend in ("triton", "fa3"):
+            decision = _place(
+                _profile(window_layer_ids=(0,), window=128),
+                target_window=128,
+                draft_backends=(backend,),
+            )
+            self.assertIsNotNone(decision.placement, backend)
         decision = _place(
             _profile(window_layer_ids=(0,), window=128),
             target_window=128,
-            draft_backends=("fa3",),
+            draft_backends=("flashinfer",),
         )
         self.assertIsNone(decision.placement)
-        self.assertIn("['fa3']", decision.declined)
+        self.assertIn("['flashinfer']", decision.declined)
         self.assertIn("triton", decision.declined)
         # A full-only draft never consults the rail rule.
-        self.assertIsNotNone(_place(_profile(), draft_backends=("fa3",)).placement)
+        self.assertIsNotNone(
+            _place(_profile(), draft_backends=("flashinfer",)).placement
+        )
 
     def test_per_depth_head_needs_one_runner_per_depth(self):
         self.assertIsNone(_place(_profile(num_layers=8, num_depths=8), 1).placement)
